title: Hook
line: …and you think you have a lead problem.
visual: YOU DON'T HAVE A (white kicker) / LEAD PROBLEM. (yellow, faint letterpress grain) + hand-painted blue brush underline. Halftone ghost word LEADS sits behind the speaker's head (chroma key).
motion: Kicker words blur in on frame 1, headline blur-scales in at 0.45s; brush underline paints on 'lead problem'; punch-in on the same word. Ghost word drifts in slowly behind the hair.

title: Series tile
line: Welcome to Coach Meet Business Series…
visual: Paper tile ep. 05 — same tile system as ep.01–04 (coach meet / business / series with blue bar).
motion: 05 rises, words land on the spoken word, tile wipes up to reveal the speaker.

title: 1 crore
line: …what it takes to build a one crore coaching business.
visual: WHAT IT TAKES TO BUILD A / ₹1 CRORE / coaching business. (series line, unchanged).
motion: Kicker word-by-word; ₹1 CRORE blur-scales in on 'one crore'; small punch-in.

title: Eyes on your offer
line: …not able to get a lot of eyeballs attracted towards your offer…
visual: New diagram, behind the speaker: line-art eyes (blue irises) on the left, dashed sight-lines to a YOUR OFFER box (coaching · consulting). Lines drawn with a hand-drawn shimmer.
motion: Offer box on 'offering'; six eyes pop on 'eyeballs'; pupils turn and sight-lines draw on 'attracted towards'; on 'not working out' the lines and box fade — attention arrives, nothing converts.

title: More leads?
line: In order to sell more, you think you would want more leads…
visual: Six more eyes join (twelve), sight-lines still faint, the offer still dim. Serif: more leads? (blue ?)
motion: 'not selling more.' on 'sell more', then swaps to 'more leads?' as the extra eyes pop on 'more leads'. Diagram floats gently.

title: The reframe
line: You don't have a lead problem, you have an offer problem.
visual: Label-column: NOT A | LEAD PROBLEM (outline, struck through with a blue brush stroke) / IT'S AN | OFFER PROBLEM. (yellow pill). Ghost word OFFER behind the speaker's head.
motion: Rule draws down; row 1 arrives on 'don't', brush strike paints across on 'lead'; yellow pill pops on 'offer' with a hard punch-in.

title: B-roll: the eye chart
line: …what you're offering, it's not very clear to them.
visual: Full-screen cutaway, dark paper-textured page: an optometrist's chart reading WHAT / DO I / ACTUALLY / GET? with 20/200…20/30 markings. Serif: it's not clear to them.
motion: Page slides up; rows land top to bottom sharp, then defocus line by line on 'not very clear'; on 'offer is not clear' the whole chart blurs further; page slides away.

title: See it / get it / go deeper
line: …very difficult for these five people to go on a deeper journey with you.
visual: New data row grammar: THEY SEE IT ●●●●● (blue people) / THEY GET IT ○○○○○ (dashed outlines) / GO DEEPER 0 (big yellow zero).
motion: Five people pop on 'five'; dashed outlines fade in beside them; the yellow 0 slams in on 'deeper journey' with a push-in.

title: Paid ads = amplifier
line: Maybe let's try paid ads… will always give me result and fast, right?
visual: New metaphor, behind the speaker: a line-art amplifier (PAID ADS) — small clean wave in (YOUR OFFER), big blue wave out (AMPLIFIED). Serif: results, fast?
motion: Triangle draws on 'paid ads'; input wave draws; the big output wave sweeps out on 'result'; blue ? pops on 'right?'.

title: Untested → louder noise
line: Even the paid ad will not work if your offer is not tested organically…
visual: Same amplifier: the input becomes jagged noise (UNTESTED OFFER), the output becomes big noise. Yellow serif headline: test it organically first.
motion: Clean waves fade, noisy waves scribble in on 'will not work'; punch-in; headline blurs in on 'tested organically'.

title: Build order
line: …before paid ads… lead generation tactics… mechanism, work on your offer.
visual: Label-column stack: 04 PAID ADS / 03 LEAD-GEN TACTICS / 02 LEAD-GEN MECHANISMS (outlines) sitting on 01 YOUR OFFER (yellow foundation).
motion: Each upper block drops in on its 'before…' and wobbles with nothing under it; on 'your offer' the yellow foundation slides in underneath, the stack lands and settles (punch-in).

title: Step back: leads or offer?
line: …always take a step back… is it the leads… or is it the offer…?
visual: STEP BACK & ASK / THE LEADS? (outline) or THE OFFER (yellow pill) → the conversion.
motion: Camera literally pulls back on 'step back'; LEADS? on 'leads', OFFER? on 'offer' then turns yellow and LEADS dims; '→ the conversion' on 'conversion'.

title: Ten viewing — work here
line: …five to ten people viewing my offer… able to understand…? That is where you need to work on.
visual: Callback of the people rows: VIEWING ten blue people / THEY GET IT ten dashed outlines + blue ? / yellow brush bracket + serif 'work here.'
motion: 5 then 10 people pop on 'five to ten'; outlines fade in on 'understand'; ? pops on 'getting?'; yellow bracket paints and 'work here.' lands on 'where you need to work on'.

title: Stop. Reflect back.
line: I want you to stop, reflect back…
motion: Hard punch-in (to 120%) on 'stop'; STOP. blur-scales in, 'reflect back.' follows on 'reflect'.

title: Which one to work on
line: …whether it is the lead… or the offer that you should be progressing towards.
visual: Callback: WHAT SHOULD YOU WORK ON? / THE LEADS? (dimmed) or THE OFFER (yellow) with a check.
motion: Options arrive on 'lead' and 'offer'; OFFER turns yellow and the check draws.

title: Have a clear offer
line: Have a clear offer and that will solve the major problem.
visual: HAVE A / CLEAR OFFER. (yellow). Ghost word CLEAR behind the speaker's head.
motion: Rack focus: the headline pulls from a heavy blur to sharp on 'clear' — the eye chart's payoff; punch-in.

title: CTA
line: Comment your offer below… I'll help you improve your offer for free. No BS.
visual: COMMENT YOUR / O F F E R key-caps / & I'll help you improve it, for free. / NO BS.
motion: Keys drop in one by one on 'offer'; serif line on 'help'; NO BS. on 'No BS'.
